This archive preserves the project’s original rationale, equations, performance reports and illustrative code. Historical paths, API names, claims and sketches can differ from the current engine. For copy-ready programs use the guides and demos; for current callable signatures use the source-derived API. Performance figures here describe reported experiments, not guaranteed frame rates.

blocks.text: Original document: [docs/SHADOW_MAPPING_AND_LIGHTING_MODELS_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/SHADOW_MAPPING_AND_LIGHTING_MODELS_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
Rendering production-quality 3D mathematical scenes and scientific animations requires flexible lighting models and hardware-accelerated shadows.

items: **Light-Space Shadow Depth Pass ([`ShadowPass.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/passes/ShadowPass.ts))**: A dedicated depth-only rasterization pass generating a high-resolution $2048 \times 2048$ `depth32float` shadow map from the primary light perspective.

**Cascaded PCF Filtering ([`shadows.wgsl`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/shaders/includes/lighting/shadows.wgsl))**: Hardware comparison sampling with 9-tap Percentage-Closer Filtering (PCF) and slope-scale adaptive depth bias.

**Curated Lighting Model Library ([`src/engine/shaders/includes/lighting/`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/shaders/includes/lighting))**: Modular WGSL lighting chunks for Physically Based Rendering (PBR), Gooch technical illustration, Cel anime shading, and Clay matte shading.
